name: Dameon Hunt
source:
A kid prodigy who is a pro at tracking down espers. He takes so little time to do his homework that he runs an occult detective business online.

His flamboyant personality may be an attempt to avoid being seen as weak due to his nerdy predilections, or he could be crazy.
